title: Knowledge graph L2-DMN: DMN File
description: One DMN file as a unit -- the `dmn:definitions` root. Shares its IRI with the l1:external-artifact for the same file, so the l2:decision-support-logic component that points at it and this subgraph name one resource. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/dmn-definitions.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for KGDmnDefinitions logical model

id.description: The identifier the source declares (an FSH instance id, a BPMN or DMN element id).

source.description: Where the node was read from: a repository path or URL.

sha256.description: Hash of the file the node was read from; pins the source.
